sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232486, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $30 a night for every standard and RV site, 2026 and 2027 rate seasons alike. Cancelling the day before or on arrival day costs a $10 service fee plus the first night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232486/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: RV NONELECTRIC 30, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30; same for 2027) + facility_use_fee_description, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Some accessible sites have a 5-amp outlet for medical equipment only.

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232486 (notice: 'There are no showers or electric, water or sewer hook-ups in the park. Some accessible sites have a 5 amp electric hookup for medical equipment use.') + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/frontcountry-camping.htm ('Cades Cove, Elkmont, and Smokemont campgrounds have 5-amp electric outlets for medical equipment use only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 142 sites in the catalog (137 bookable online): loops A, B & C, D and F. Max Vehicle Length runs 22-40 ft, 81 sites at 40 ft; about 45 pull-throughs. Tents are not allowed in Loop F. Six people per site.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232486 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232486 (notices: 'TENTS are NOT allowed in Loop F', 'A maximum of 6 people may occupy a campsite'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Restrooms with cold running water and flush toilets; dump station with potable water. Heat-treated firewood sold at the Smokemont Riding Stables in season.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232486 ('flush toilets, drinking water and sinks'; 'There are no showers') + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/frontcountry-camping.htm ('Dump stations with potable water are located at Cades Cove, Cosby, Deep Creek, Look Rock, and Smokemont campgrounds'; 'Showers are not available in the park'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open all year, but only loops A and B & C stay open in winter: loops D and F are bookable through Oct 31 and closed from Nov 1 (recreation.gov calendar, read 2026-10-22). The camp office may be open only intermittently November-April.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/frontcountry-camping.htm ('Cades Cove and Smokemont Campgrounds are open year-round') + recreation.gov notice ('Cades Cove and Smokemont campgrounds are the only campgrounds open year round') + availability calendar by loop, read 2026-10-22

status.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/conditions.htm ('Cades Cove and Smokemont campgrounds remain open year-round') + recreation.gov calendar taking bookings through April 2027, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservation required; up to 6 months ahead. Check in at the campground office on arrival (or by noon next day if it is closed) or the booking may be treated as a no-show. 14 consecutive nights, no more than 60 nights a year in park campgrounds. US 441 can close for snow or wind; refunds are not given for 441 closures.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232486 (notices: 'Cades Cove and Smokemont campgrounds are the only campgrounds open year round and require a reservation. Reservations may be made up to 6 months in advance.', 'The stay limit is 14 consecutive days', check-in notice; facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/frontcountry-camping.htm ('14 consecutive days with no more than 60 total days in a calendar year'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/frontcountry-camping.htm ('senior or access pass ... These two passes do provide discounts on camping fees'; passes sold at Smokemont), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS-operated (not concession), reservation-only. Confirmed $30 (2026) for all sites and no hookups (electric 0; adds water/sewer none, 5-amp medical outlets in note). Added 142 sites, 40-ft max, pull-throughs, flush toilets/water/dump, no showers, open year-round (loops D and F close Nov 1), open now, 6-month window, 14-night max, senior/access discount. Note unchanged (AWH's creekside text is not a field). NPS API was rate-limited (DEMO_KEY); nps.gov pages read instead.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov lists the campground at 828-497-9270 (park main line (865) 436-1200).
Website is recreation.gov only; the NPS campground page is https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/smokemont-campground.htm (could be added beside it).
